scope: Original ASUS login/TLS, center database/installer and UU download/checksum path with owned worker
Root-private bounded checksummed journal; no raw configuration/account/log payload
Three owned 96 MiB ext4 state images; actual partial writes, failed rename, disk pressure, corruption and forced VM cuts
limits: Alpine 6.12/QEMU; no physical router, original 4.1 kernel or NAND/UBIFS durability claim
Real UU account/traffic and arbitrary hostile root writers not tested
Damaged/incomplete history is retained read-only and recording becomes best effort; it never owns plugin or UU recovery
Read-only inference of an interrupted operation is not a claim that a plugin was rolled back
